title: loop state
description: What each maker/checker cycle did, and what the goal contract's checks returned. Written after each cycle, not at the end from memory. loop-lint enforces this shape; the two are kept in step by rule L7, which compares this file's required keys against the ones the gate actually demands.

feature.description: The feature id, matching the goal contract beside this file and the register.

satisfied.description: True only when the last cycle's checker returned pass.

maker.description: What changed in this cycle, in a sentence.

results.description: One entry per check the checker ran. A pass needs one for every check in the contract.

id.description: The verification id from the goal contract.

exit.description: The exit code the command returned. Required for a command check in a passing cycle.

note.description: What was seen. Required for an observation check in a passing cycle.
